correctness.rationale: For every p(3)=289q(3) with Newman polynomials, integral carries return to zero and stay in a closed 32-state set. The 12 dead states are forward-invariant, so return paths use only 20 live states. On every one of the 26 live edges the unique superincreasing five-bit encoding shifts as denominator digits and enforces precisely the convolution coefficients of R(x)=1-x²-x³+x⁴+x⁵. Initial zero state and arbitrary-length induction prove p=Rq. Complete exact checks and a stand-alone verifier reconstruct the certificate. Finite bounded examples are illustrative, not the universal proof.
